interpretation: This milestone implements and starts matched non-developmental controls. It contains no measured comparison outcome yet and cannot establish a developmental-organization advantage or mechanism.
limitations: One replicate per task and arm is exploratory; tasks are not substitutes for independently initialized population replicates.
The requested call/token ceilings are matched, but early stopping can leave unused budget.
The single-long arm is one call; other arms use up to eight logical calls.
The API model alias and prompts define this pilot's scope; results do not generalize automatically to other model versions or tasks.
The answer-bearing evaluator records remain on the isolated cluster filesystem; no model receives hidden answers.

first_controller_attempt.retry_policy: Never resend; score as ungraded zero and preserve in denominator.
